title: This Animal Pushes Out Its Own Organs, Then Regrows Them

scenes.text: When attacked, this animal pushes its own insides out.
Its muscles squeeze fluid until the body wall splits, and its gut spills out.
Some species also fire out sticky tubes, called Cuvierian tubules, to deter crabs and fish.
Then comes the part that sounds impossible: it regrows them. Lost organs are rebuilt in a few weeks.
Scientists still aren't sure why it does this: escaping predators, flushing parasites, or surviving low oxygen.

subject: sea cucumber
description:
When attacked, this animal pushes its own insides out.
Sea cucumbers expel their gut and regrow it in a few weeks, and scientists still debate exactly why.
Would you want this superpower?
first_comment: Which animal has the strangest defense? We can rank them.
